extracted.name: Gluten-Free Cream of Chicken Soup Replacer
extracted.description: Use this gluten-free cream of chicken soup in recipes calling for store-bought condensed soup that typically contains wheat and gluten ingredients.
instruction_lines: Stir chicken stock, milk, and cornstarch together in a small saucepan until cornstarch is dissolved.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until bubbling, about 5 minutes.
Reduce heat to medium-low; continue to cook and stir until mixture is very thick, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
